_about: George Smeaton (1814-1889), professor of exegetical theology at New College, Edinburgh (Free Church of Scotland): The Doctrine of the Atonement as taught by Christ Himself (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, 1868), The Doctrine of the Atonement as taught by the Apostles (1870), and The Doctrine of the Holy Spirit (Cunningham Lectures, 1882). Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing. Merged 2026-10-03 with lane A's round-11 copy, which listed the same three books; for Christ Himself it used the other Toronto scan (doctrineofatonem00smeauoft), the same 1868 edition at the same OCR quality, kept here as an alternate.

smeaton-atonement-christ-1868: The Doctrine of the Atonement as taught by Christ Himself (Edinburgh, 1868)
smeaton-atonement-apostles-1870: The Doctrine of the Atonement as taught by the Apostles, with historical appendix (Edinburgh, 1870)
smeaton-holy-spirit-1882: The Doctrine of the Holy Spirit, the ninth series of the Cunningham Lectures (Edinburgh, 1882)

_alternates.doctrineofatonem00smeauoft, doctrineofat: Other copies of the 1868/1871 Christ Himself.
_alternates.doctrineofholysp00smea (1889): Second edition of the Holy Spirit.
